isGlowEnabled.description: Drop shadow glow on these words

position.title: Position
position.description: Fixed position. Use a number for pixels or a percent like 12%.

autoHighlight.title: Auto highlight
autoHighlight.description: When on, pick a highlight word if htmlText has no bold word. When off, only words marked bold in htmlText are highlighted.

ignoreBolds.title: Ignore bolds
ignoreBolds.description: When on, no word is highlighted. Bold marks in htmlText and auto highlight are ignored.

waveform-audio.title: Waveform Audio Visualization
waveform-audio.description: Create animated or static waveform visualizations with customizable colors, styling, and effects

trackName.description: Name of the track (used for the ID)

trackType.description: Lock copies another track. Sequence plays children in order. Aligned uses start and duration.

start.description: Start of this track in its parent scene, in seconds

startOffset.description: Negative trim from the head, in seconds. The end stays put.

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Used when the track is aligned. A lock takes its length from the target.

lock.description: Lock start and duration to a sibling or parent track

attachedToId.description: Parent to insert into. BaseScene, or another scene track name.

useFrequencyData.description: Use frequency data for the waves type (default: false). The static type always uses frequency data.

smoothNormalisation.description: Frame-based smoothing control (0 = no smoothing, 1 = default, >1 = more smoothing)

verticalTransform.description: Transform waveform to vertical orientation (90 degree rotation)

leftVerticalPos.description: Position from left edge as percentage (can be negative to go outside boundary)

rightVerticalPos.description: Position from right edge as percentage (can be negative to go outside boundary)

rotation.description: Container rotation in degrees (default: 0, can be used instead of verticalTransform)

waveform-audio-scene.title: Waveform Audio Scene
waveform-audio-scene.description: A dynamic audio visualization with waveform, image effects, and customizable text overlays
